title: AlignBench: Benchmarking Chinese Alignment of Large Language Models
authors_zh: Xiao Liu、Xuanyu Lei、Shengyuan Wang、Yue Huang、Zhuoer Feng、Bosi Wen、Jiale Cheng、Pei Ke、Yifan Xu、Weng Lam Tam、Xiaohan Zhang、Lichao Sun、Xiaotao Gu、Hongning Wang、Jing Zhang、Minlie Huang、Yuxiao Dong、Jie Tang
paper_type_zh: 评测、裁判或量规数据论文
best_for_zh: 需要构建、校准或审计开放式模型评测的研究者。
one_line: AlignBench combines real Chinese user scenarios, human-verified references, and rule-calibrated judging to assess multidimensional alignment.
AlignBench 结合真实中文用户场景、人工核验参考答案与规则校准评判，衡量多维对齐能力。
why: AlignBench combines real Chinese user scenarios, human-verified references, and rule-calibrated judging to assess multidimensional alignment.
inclusion_reason: AlignBench 结合真实中文用户场景、人工核验参考答案与规则校准评判，衡量多维对齐能力。

title: Problem
问题
html: Chinese LLMs developed rapidly, but early alignment benchmarks were often translations of English tasks and poorly represented Chinese culture, expression, knowledge context, and real user needs. Simple holistic GPT-4 scoring is also vulnerable to missing references, scale drift, and limited Chinese capability. The paper asks how to build a native Chinese, multidimensional, interpretable alignment benchmark and make LLM-as-a-judge reliable on both knowledge-intensive and open-ended questions.
中文大模型快速发展，但早期对齐 benchmark 多由英文任务翻译而来，难以覆盖中文文化、表达方式、知识语境和真实用户需求；简单使用 GPT-4 总体打分又容易受 reference 缺失、评分尺度漂移和中文能力限制影响。论文研究如何构建原生中文、多维且可解释的对齐评测，并让自动 LLM-as-a-judge 在知识密集和开放式问题上保持较高可靠性。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: AlignBench uses a human-in-the-loop pipeline to build 683 native Chinese queries rooted in real scenarios across eight major categories, each with a human-verified reference. Knowledge-intensive questions additionally include URLs and quotations from reliable webpages to reduce reference hallucination. Automatic evaluation uses a rule-calibrated, multidimensional LLM-as-a-judge with chain-of-thought explanations and category-specific scoring rules. Data, model outputs, and evaluation code are released.

AlignBench 通过 human-in-the-loop 流程构建 683 条源于真实场景的中文 query，覆盖 8 个主类别，并为每题提供人工核验的参考答案。知识密集型问题还附可靠网页的 URL 与原文引用，降低 reference 幻觉。自动评测采用 rule-calibrated、multi-dimensional、带 CoT 解释的 LLM-as-a-judge，对不同类别使用相应评分规则；官方仓库开放数据、模型回答和评价代码。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Collect questions: Candidate queries are gathered from real Chinese use cases across eight categories including knowledge, reasoning, writing, role-play, professional capability, and safety.
  2. Human filtering: Ambiguous, easy, and translation-like questions are removed to preserve naturalness, evaluability, and discrimination.
  3. Create references: Annotators write and cross-check references; knowledge questions also store trusted webpage URLs and supporting quotations.
  4. Design rubrics: Category-specific multidimensional scoring rules calibrate the relationship between dimensions and aggregate scores.
  5. Automatic evaluation: The judge reads the query, response, reference, and rubric, generates an analysis, and assigns scores. Human comparisons validate the protocol, and all resources are released.

1. 收集问题：从真实中文使用场景整理候选 query，覆盖知识、推理、写作、角色扮演、专业能力和安全等 8 类。
  2. 人工筛选：删除歧义、低难度和翻译腔问题，确保问题自然、可评价且具有区分度。
  3. 制作参考：标注者编写并交叉核验 reference；知识题同时保存可信网页 URL 和支持性 quotation。
  4. 设计 rubric：按任务类别定义多维评分标准，并以规则校准不同维度与总分的关系。
  5. 自动评价：judge 读取 query、response、reference 和 rubric，先生成分析再给分；通过人工对照验证，并公开全部评测资源。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Human comparisons show that the rule-calibrated multidimensional judge is more stable and interpretable than simple holistic prompting. A dedicated Chinese evaluator, CritiqueLLM, recovers about 95% of GPT-4’s evaluation capability. AlignBench has also been adopted by multiple Chinese model teams, indicating practical discrimination. The evidence supports native Chinese data and evidence-grounded references, but 683 questions remain susceptible to leaderboard tuning and contamination, requiring continual monitoring.

作者比较人工评分与自动评分，证明 rule-calibrated 多维 judge 比简单总体提示更稳定且更可解释；专门训练的中文 evaluator CritiqueLLM 可恢复约 95% 的 GPT-4 评价能力。AlignBench 也被多种中文模型团队采用，说明任务覆盖具有实际区分度。证据支持中文原生数据和证据化 reference 的价值，但 benchmark 只有 683 题，模型频繁针对公开榜单优化后，长期区分力和污染风险需要持续监控。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier Chinese benchmarks emphasized knowledge QA or translated English tasks, while MT-Bench-style methods lacked systematic evidence and Chinese-specific category design. AlignBench combines native real-world queries, human references, web evidence, and multidimensional judging with category-calibrated rules. LLM-as-a-judge and chain-of-thought scoring are not new; the contribution is high-quality Chinese alignment data engineering and an auditable protocol.
已有中文 benchmark 多偏知识问答或英文翻译，MT-Bench 类方法也缺少系统证据和中文类别设计。AlignBench 的新意是将原生真实 query、人工 reference、网页证据和多维 judge 结合，并为不同题型校准评分规则。LLM-as-a-judge 和 CoT 打分本身不新；主要贡献是面向中文对齐的高质量数据工程和可审计评价协议。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Public-set contamination: All 683 questions and references are public and may enter later training or leaderboard-specific optimization.
  2. Judge dependence: Automatic scores inherit GPT-4 or specialized-evaluator preferences and require human auditing.
  3. Temporal drift: Web evidence for knowledge questions ages, so references and URLs need versioned updates.
  4. Cultural representation: Chinese alignment does not cover every region, dialect, or value group, and annotator backgrounds should be more transparent.

1. 公开集污染：683 条题目和参考全部公开，后续模型可能直接训练或针对榜单调优。
  2. judge 依赖：自动分数仍受 GPT-4 或专用 evaluator 偏好影响，不能代替人工抽查。
  3. 时效性：知识题的网页证据会过时，reference 与 URL 需要版本化更新。
  4. 文化代表性：“中文对齐”并不等于覆盖所有地区、方言和价值群体，标注者背景应更透明。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: AlignBench can serve as a comprehensive regression suite for Chinese assistants and as a template for query-reference-evidence-multidimensional-score judge data. Researchers should report category- and dimension-level results rather than only an aggregate score, while checking evidence dates and quotations for knowledge items. Training requires a separate split with test isolation. For Track 7, it spans human-verified judgment, grounding, and LLM-as-a-judge data.

AlignBench 可作为中文助手的综合回归测试，也可借鉴其“query—reference—evidence—multi-dimensional score”格式构建新的 judge 数据。研究者应报告分类别与分维度结果，而不是只引用总分；知识题还应检查证据日期和引用正确性。若用于模型训练，必须另建训练集并保持测试隔离。对 Track 7 而言，它同时属于 human-verified judgment、grounding 与 LLM-as-a-judge 数据工作。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. One-sentence positioning: A native Chinese alignment benchmark with human references, grounded knowledge items, and multidimensional LLM judging.
  2. Method takeaway: Eight categories, 683 real queries, human-verified references, and webpage URLs and quotations.
  3. Data takeaway: Questions, references, model outputs, dimension scores, and evaluation code are public.
  4. Evidence anchor: A specialized Chinese evaluator recovers about 95% of GPT-4 judging capability.
  5. Reuse decision: It is important Chinese alignment data, but public contamination and aging evidence require attention.

1. 一句话定位：原生中文、人工 reference、证据化知识题和多维 LLM judge 的对齐 benchmark。
  2. 方法抓手：8 类、683 条真实 query、人工核验 reference、网页 URL 与 quotation。
  3. 数据抓手：公开问题、参考、模型回答、维度分数和自动评价代码。
  4. 证据锚点：专用中文 evaluator 可恢复约 95% GPT-4 评价能力。
  5. 复用决定：中文对齐评测的重要数据；需防止公开集污染和知识证据过时。
